items.title: Zoetis (NYSE:ZTS) posts better-than-expected sales in Q3 2026
items.summary: Animal health company Zoetis (NYSE:ZTS) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q3 2026, but revenue fell by 1.3% year on year to $2.39 billion. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $9.27 billion, close to analysts’ consensus estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.75 per share was 15.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
